description_zh: 萨帕尔穆拉特·尼亚佐夫（1940-2006）是土库曼斯坦总统（1990-2006）。长期独裁执政，撰写意识形态著作《鲁赫纳马》。通过黄金建设和中立外交在地区事务中发挥重要作用。实现了土库曼斯坦的长期稳定和发展。
description_en: Saparmurat Niyazov (1940-2006) was President of Turkmenistan (1990-2006). Long-term dictatorial rule. Wrote ideological work "Rukhnama". Through golden construction and neutral diplomacy, played significant role in regional affairs. Achieved Turkmenistan's long-term stability and development.
reason_zh: 尼亚佐夫的治理智慧体现在个人崇拜和意识形态控制中。通过黄金建设和中立外交在地区事务中发挥重要作用。鲁赫纳马体现了土库曼斯坦的意识形态控制。他的长期执政实现了国家的稳定和发展。
reason_en: Niyazov's governance wisdom exemplified in personal worship and ideological control. Through golden construction and neutral diplomacy, played significant role in regional affairs. "Rukhnama" reflected Turkmenistan's ideological control. Long-term rule achieved stability and development.
